cohort: 216 children aged six years or younger diagnosed with bronchiolitis
finding: Age, exposure to cigarette smoking, preterm birth, low birth weight, cesarean section, history of mechanical ventilation, breastfeeding less than 6 months, and substandard living conditions were associated with an increased risk of severe bronchiolitis.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of severe bronchiolitis.
